answer_card.title: What changed in ansible-core 2.19 and how to prepare
answer_card.answer_md:
ansible-core 2.19 (ansible-core 2.19) brings a **templating engine overhaul** and a new feature called **Data Tagging**. Together they report many problematic behaviors that used to go unnoticed, improving security, performance and user experience.

Backward compatibility was kept where practical, but some breaking changes were necessary. Test your playbooks and roles in a **staging environment** with this release before rolling it out.
